title: [main] - Serial and Lot number mismatch when item is produced via Production Order and moved to inventory through an Internal Put-away
summary: A data-driven validation check was added to the warehouse activity registration to ensure that lot numbers match the posted item ledger entries when internal put-aways process items from production orders.
key_points: Warehouse activity registration now validates lot and serial number tracking before registration completes
The fix compares put-away lines against actual posted Item Ledger Entries instead of relying only on configuration flags
For put-away lines with serial numbers, the system resolves the corresponding open item ledger entry and verifies lot number consistency
Prevents lot number mismatches when items move from production orders to inventory via internal put-aways
Adds enforcement of lot requirements at registration time rather than skipping validation
